module.title: Unit 4: Artificial Intelligence & Future Careers
module.objective: Mampu berspekulasi mengenai masa depan lapangan kerja di era AI menggunakan future perfect & future continuous.

content.summary: In this mission, you will read an informative article about how computers and robots are changing the job market. You will explore predictions about future careers and examine how workers prepare for technological changes using specific future tenses.

linguisticTarget.grammar: Future Continuous (will be + verb-ing) to describe ongoing activities at a specific time in the future, and Future Perfect (will have + past participle) to describe actions completed before a future moment.
linguisticTarget.vocabulary: Key terms related to technology, employment, skill development, and workplace trends such as automation, workforce, upskill, and remote work.
linguisticTarget.readingStrategy: Scanning for future time markers (such as 'by 2035' or 'in ten years') and skimming paragraphs to identify main predictions.

learningObjectives: Understand the main idea and key arguments in a B1 text about AI and employment.
Locate specific predictions by scanning for dates and future time markers.
Recognize and interpret sentences with the future continuous and future perfect tenses.

contextWarmup.prompt: Which sentence best describes an action that will be completed before a specific point in the future?
options: By 2035, automation will have changed millions of office jobs.
In 2035, robots are working every single day.
By 2035, people will be work at home.
contextWarmup.explanation: The phrase 'will have changed' is in the future perfect tense. It shows that the change will finish before the year 2035.

rules: Use Future Continuous (Subject + will be + verb-ing) to describe an activity that will be in progress at a specific time in the future: 'In ten years, doctors will be working with computer assistants.'
Use Future Perfect (Subject + will have + past participle) to say that an action will be completed before a certain future time: 'By 2040, companies will have introduced new training programs.'
Look for time markers like 'by + year' for the Future Perfect, and 'in + number of years' or 'at this time next year' for the Future Continuous.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Confusing Ongoing Actions with Completed Actions
commonTrap.explanation: Learners often mix up 'will be doing' with 'will have done'. Remember that 'will be doing' focuses on an action taking place continuously, while 'will have done' focuses on a finished result before a deadline.
commonTrap.wrong: By 2030, robots will be replaced factory workers. (Incorrect form)
commonTrap.correct: By 2030, robots will have replaced factory workers.

content.passageTitle: Working in 2035: How Technology Shapes Careers
paragraphs: Technology is moving faster than ever before, and the world of work is experiencing significant changes. Over the next decade, artificial intelligence will take on many everyday duties. Experts believe that by 2035, smart computer programs will have automated millions of routine tasks, including data entry, basic filing, and simple customer inquiries.

Because of these rapid changes, several old occupations will have become obsolete. However, this does not mean human workers will disappear completely. Instead, the global workforce will be adapting to fresh challenges. In ten years, most office staff will be working alongside digital assistants that help them organize information and solve problems.

To stay successful, workers must learn new abilities. Companies are setting up special programs to upskill their staff in creative thinking, technical repair, and communication. In addition, remote work will remain popular, meaning professionals will be collaborating across international time zones without travelling to a physical office building every morning.

Ultimately, the future job market will reward flexibility and curiosity. By the time today's teenagers finish their university degrees, entire new careers will have appeared. People who continue to develop their human skills will thrive in this modern working environment.

content.summary: Use the future continuous to describe activities that will be in progress at a future time. Use the future perfect for actions that will be complete before a future time. Add a time phrase such as by 2040 or in ten years to make your meaning clear.

blueprintItems.title: Step 1: Describe an Activity in Progress
blueprintItems.example: In ten years, many nurses will be using AI tools to check patient records.

blueprintItems.title: Step 3: Add a Future Time Marker
blueprintItems.formula: By + future time marker, subject + will have + past participle / subject + will be + verb-ing
blueprintItems.example: By 2040, AI will have taken over some routine tasks, and people will be doing more creative work.

mechanicsRules.rule: Use will be before a verb ending in -ing for an activity in progress at a future time.
mechanicsRules.badExample: By 2040, many workers will using AI tools.
mechanicsRules.goodExample: By 2040, many workers will be using AI tools.
mechanicsRules.why: The future continuous needs will be before the -ing form of the main verb.

mechanicsRules.rule: Use the past participle after will have.
mechanicsRules.badExample: By 2035, robots will have replace some factory workers.
mechanicsRules.goodExample: By 2035, robots will have replaced some factory workers.
mechanicsRules.why: The future perfect uses will have followed by a past participle.

mechanicsRules.rule: Use a comma after an opening time phrase when it comes before the main clause.
mechanicsRules.badExample: By the time I graduate I will be looking for a job in technology.
mechanicsRules.goodExample: By the time I graduate, I will be looking for a job in technology.
mechanicsRules.why: The comma helps separate the opening time phrase from the main clause.

content.audioGuidance: Speak at a steady pace and make the main syllable of important words clear. Use a falling tone for statements and a rising tone for genuine yes-or-no questions. Pause briefly between ideas.

pillars.explanation: Say each vowel clearly in words such as workforce, future, and obsolete. Do not rush through longer words.

pillars.explanation: Listen for the strong syllable in words such as automation and intelligence. A clear main stress makes the word easier to understand.

pillars.name: Future Forms
pillars.target: Use future continuous and future perfect clearly
pillars.explanation: Use will be plus an -ing verb for an activity in progress, as in 'People will be working remotely.' Use will have plus a past participle for a completed change, as in 'Some jobs will have changed by 2040.'

pillars.name: Natural Pauses
pillars.explanation: Pause after a time phrase or a main idea. This helps listeners follow your predictions and examples.

stressPairs.shiftExplanation: The main stress is on MA in both words. Say the final syllables lightly.

The stress moves from the first syllable in obsolete to the third syllable in obsoletely.

reading.question: What is the main topic of the passage?
options: The history of personal computers in modern companies
How artificial intelligence and automation are altering future jobs
Why teenagers should avoid working in offices
reading.answer: How artificial intelligence and automation are altering future jobs
reading.explanation: The entire text discusses future careers, automation, new workplace skills, and how workers adapt to technology.

reading.question: According to paragraph 1, what will smart computer programs have automated by 2035?
options: Every single human activity
Millions of routine tasks like filing and data entry
All international transport systems
reading.answer: Millions of routine tasks like filing and data entry
reading.explanation: The first paragraph states that by 2035, software will have automated millions of routine tasks, including data entry, basic filing, and simple inquiries.

reading.question: What will happen to some traditional jobs because of technological advances?
options: They will become obsolete.
They will pay twice as much money.
They will remain exactly the same forever.
reading.explanation: Paragraph 2 specifically notes that several old occupations will have become obsolete due to rapid changes.

reading.question: What will office staff be doing in ten years, according to paragraph 2?
options: Working alongside digital assistants
Refusing to use computers
Building their own factories
reading.explanation: Paragraph 2 mentions that in ten years, most office staff will be working alongside digital assistants that help organize information.

reading.question: Why are companies creating special training programs for their workers?
options: To encourage workers to leave their jobs
To upskill their staff in creative thinking and communication
To teach workers how to write by hand
reading.answer: To upskill their staff in creative thinking and communication
reading.explanation: Paragraph 3 explains that companies are setting up programs to upskill staff in creative thinking, technical repair, and communication.

reading.question: What does the passage say about remote work in the coming years?
options: It will completely stop by next year.
It will stay popular as staff collaborate across time zones.
It will only be allowed on weekends.
reading.answer: It will stay popular as staff collaborate across time zones.
reading.explanation: The third paragraph states that remote work will remain popular, allowing professionals to collaborate across time zones without travelling to an office every morning.

reading.question: Which verb form in paragraph 3 describes an ongoing activity across time zones?
options: will have appeared
will be collaborating
became obsolete
reading.explanation: 'Will be collaborating' is in the future continuous tense, expressing an ongoing activity in the future.

reading.question: What prediction is made about the time today's teenagers finish university?
options: Entire new careers will have appeared.
Offices will have closed permanently.
Nobody will study computer science anymore.
reading.answer: Entire new careers will have appeared.
reading.explanation: Paragraph 4 states: 'By the time today's teenagers finish their university degrees, entire new careers will have appeared.'

reading.question: Which personal qualities will the future job market reward?
options: Flexibility and curiosity
Physical strength and speed
Silence and strict routines
reading.explanation: The beginning of paragraph 4 notes that 'the future job market will reward flexibility and curiosity.'

reading.question: What is the author's overall attitude towards the future of work?
options: Negative, because robots will replace all human workers
Realistic yet hopeful, encouraging people to learn and adapt
Uninterested, because nothing will change significantly
reading.answer: Realistic yet hopeful, encouraging people to learn and adapt
reading.explanation: The author explains that while routines will change and some jobs will disappear, humans can adapt, upskill, and thrive by developing their unique abilities.

reading.question: Which preposition correctly completes the sentence: 'She is responsible _____ supervising quality assurance.'
options: for
with
to
at

reading.question: What distinction exists between 'economic' and 'economical'?
options: 'Economic' relates to the economy, whereas 'economical' means avoiding waste or saving money.
'Economic' means inexpensive, whereas 'economical' relates to government finance.
Both terms are completely interchangeable in formal English.
'Economical' is only used as a noun, whereas 'economic' is an adverb.
reading.answer: 'Economic' relates to the economy, whereas 'economical' means avoiding waste or saving money.
reading.explanation: 'Economic' refers to national financial systems, while 'economical' refers to frugality or efficiency.

reading.question: Select the sentence expressing an unfulfilled past obligation using modal perfects:

We can verify the vendor's references after signing the agreement.
We will have verified the vendor's references by tomorrow afternoon.
reading.answer: We should have verified the vendor's references before signing the agreement.
reading.explanation: 'Should have + past participle' expresses regret or an unfulfilled past action.

reading.question: According to the workplace policy, what is the primary consequence of missing a project milestone?

Clients are notified only after the product is officially deployed.
reading.answer: The project lead must submit a revised timeline and conduct a risk assessment.
reading.explanation: Standard corporate policy dictates remediation through timeline review and risk mitigation.

reading.question: Which connector indicates a contrast between two independent clauses?

practicumQuestions.promptSentence: Effective delegation empowers team members to make _____ decisions.
practicumQuestions.explanation: Audio lengkap: 'Effective delegation empowers team members to make autonomous decisions.'. Kata: 'autonomous'.

practicumQuestions.audioText: Although quarterly revenue increased, operating costs remained unexpectedly high.
practicumQuestions.instruction: Dengarkan audio dan ketik kata atau frasa yang hilang:
practicumQuestions.promptSentence: Although quarterly revenue increased, operating costs remained _____ high.
practicumQuestions.explanation: Audio lengkap: 'Although quarterly revenue increased, operating costs remained unexpectedly high.'. Kata yang hilang: 'unexpectedly'.

practicumQuestions.audioText: We should have conducted a comprehensive feasibility study earlier.
practicumQuestions.instruction: Dengarkan kalimat dan susun kata menjadi urutan yang tepat:
practicumQuestions.targetSentence: We should have conducted a comprehensive feasibility study earlier
practicumQuestions.explanation: Urutan benar: 'We should have conducted a comprehensive feasibility study earlier.'.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Rewrite the sentence using the future continuous.
practicumQuestions.promptText: At 10 a.m. in 2040, nurses use AI to check patient records.
practicumQuestions.hint: Use will be followed by a verb ending in -ing.
targetAnswers: At 10 a.m. in 2040, nurses will be using AI to check patient records.
practicumQuestions.explanation: Use will be using to show that the activity will be in progress at a particular future time.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Rewrite the sentence using the future perfect.
practicumQuestions.promptText: By 2035, the company completes its staff training.
practicumQuestions.hint: Use will have followed by the past participle of complete.
targetAnswers: By 2035, the company will have completed its staff training.
practicumQuestions.explanation: The future perfect describes something that will be complete before a future time.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Join the ideas with before and use the future perfect in the main clause.
practicumQuestions.promptText: Lena starts her new job. She learns to use the AI system.
practicumQuestions.hint: Put the learning first and use will have learned.
targetAnswers: Lena will have learned to use the AI system before she starts her new job.
practicumQuestions.explanation: Use the future perfect for the learning that will be complete before Lena starts her job.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Join the two ideas with while.
practicumQuestions.promptText: AI checks simple forms. Workers help customers with complex questions.
practicumQuestions.hint: Use while to show that the two activities happen at the same time.
targetAnswers: While AI is checking simple forms, workers will be helping customers with complex questions.
Workers will be helping customers with complex questions while AI is checking simple forms.
practicumQuestions.explanation: While connects two activities that happen at the same time. Keep the future continuous form for the future activity.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Join the ideas with because to give a reason.
practicumQuestions.promptText: Maya will study computer science. She wants to work with AI.
practicumQuestions.hint: Use because before the reason.
targetAnswers: Maya will study computer science because she wants to work with AI.
practicumQuestions.explanation: Because introduces the reason Maya will study computer science.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Join the ideas with although.
practicumQuestions.promptText: Some routine jobs will change. People will still need creative skills.
practicumQuestions.hint: Although introduces an idea that contrasts with the main point.
targetAnswers: Although some routine jobs will change, people will still need creative skills.
People will still need creative skills although some routine jobs will change.
practicumQuestions.explanation: Although connects two ideas that contrast. Use a comma when the although clause comes first.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Correct the capital letters, punctuation, and verb form.
practicumQuestions.promptText: by 2040 many workers will using ai every day
practicumQuestions.hint: Start with a capital, add a comma after the time phrase, and use will be using.
targetAnswers: By 2040, many workers will be using AI every day.
practicumQuestions.explanation: Use a capital at the start, a comma after the opening time phrase, the full future continuous form, and a full stop.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Correct the sentence.
practicumQuestions.promptText: by the time Omar retires robots will have replace many tools
practicumQuestions.hint: Add a comma after the opening clause and use the past participle of replace.
targetAnswers: By the time Omar retires, robots will have replaced many tools.
practicumQuestions.explanation: Capitalize the first word, add a comma after the opening time clause, and use replaced after will have.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Write one sentence about a job that may change by 2040. Use the future perfect.
practicumQuestions.promptText: What change will have happened in a job by 2040?
practicumQuestions.hint: Begin with By 2040 and use will have plus a past participle.
targetAnswers: By 2040, teachers will have added more AI activities to their lessons.
By 2040, many drivers will have learned to use new vehicle technology.
practicumQuestions.explanation: A suitable answer gives a prediction about something that will be complete by 2040 and uses will have with a past participle.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Write two sentences about your future career. Use the future continuous in one sentence and the future perfect in the other.
practicumQuestions.promptText: What will you be doing in your career, and what will you have achieved by 2040?
practicumQuestions.hint: Use will be plus an -ing verb for an activity, and will have plus a past participle for an achievement.
targetAnswers: In 2040, I will be helping people solve problems. By then, I will have gained useful work experience.
In 2040, I will be working with technology. By then, I will have completed my professional training.
practicumQuestions.explanation: A suitable response uses the future continuous for an activity in progress and the future perfect for an achievement completed by a future time.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Speak for at least 30 seconds. Describe a job you might like to do and how AI could affect it.
practicumQuestions.audioPrompt: Tell me about a career you are interested in and how it may change in the future.
storyPoints: Name the career you are interested in and explain why it appeals to you.
Describe one way artificial intelligence may change this job by 2040.
Say what skills you will be learning to prepare for the future.
practicumQuestions.targetSentence: By 2040, people in this career will be using AI tools, and I will have learned new digital skills.
practicumQuestions.phonetic: /baɪ ˌtwenti ˈfɔːti ˈpiːpəl wɪl bi ˈjuːzɪŋ eɪ aɪ tuːlz/
practicumQuestions.explanation: Use the future continuous for work in progress at a future time and the future perfect for skills completed by then.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Speak for at least 30 seconds. Imagine a typical working day in 2040.
practicumQuestions.audioPrompt: Describe what workers will be doing in 2040 and what changes will have happened by then.
storyPoints: Describe where people will be working and whether they will be working remotely.
Explain how automation may change everyday tasks.
Say which skills workers will have developed by 2040.
practicumQuestions.targetSentence: In 2040, many workers will be working remotely, and the workforce will have learned to use new technology.
practicumQuestions.phonetic: /ɪn ˌtwenti ˈfɔːti ˈmeni ˈwɜːkəz wɪl bi ˈwɜːkɪŋ rɪˈməʊtli/
practicumQuestions.explanation: Organise your ideas in time order and support your predictions with examples.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Take part in a live call. Answer the career adviser's question and give one reason for your opinion.
practicumQuestions.audioPrompt: A careers adviser asks whether automation will remove many jobs.
practicumQuestions.scenarioContext: You are on a call with a careers adviser discussing how automation may affect jobs in your area.
practicumQuestions.characterRole: You are a student. Share a prediction about jobs and explain why you think this change may happen.
practicumQuestions.targetSentence: Some routine jobs will have changed by 2040 because companies will be using more automation.
practicumQuestions.explanation: Make a clear prediction and use will have plus a past participle for a completed change.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Take part in a live call. Explain how workers can prepare for changes caused by AI.
practicumQuestions.audioPrompt: Your colleague asks what workers should do if some skills become less useful.
practicumQuestions.scenarioContext: You are speaking to a colleague during an online meeting about training for future jobs.
practicumQuestions.characterRole: You are a team member. Suggest one way to upskill and explain how it could help workers.
practicumQuestions.targetSentence: Workers will be learning digital skills so they can move into new roles.
practicumQuestions.explanation: Give a practical suggestion and use the future continuous to describe ongoing learning.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Take part in a live call. Discuss the advantages and one possible difficulty of remote work.
practicumQuestions.audioPrompt: A friend asks whether remote work will be common in the future.
practicumQuestions.scenarioContext: You are on a video call with a friend comparing office work and remote work in the future.
practicumQuestions.characterRole: You are a student. Predict how people will be working and mention one benefit or challenge.
practicumQuestions.targetSentence: By 2030, more people will be working remotely, although some may miss talking to their colleagues in person.
practicumQuestions.explanation: Respond to the question with a prediction and a balanced comment.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Take part in a live call. Explain how you would respond if part of your job became obsolete.
practicumQuestions.audioPrompt: An interviewer asks how you would deal with a job that changes because of AI.
practicumQuestions.scenarioContext: You are on a practice interview call about adapting to changes in the job market.
practicumQuestions.characterRole: You are a job applicant. Explain how you would learn new skills if some tasks became obsolete.
practicumQuestions.targetSentence: If some tasks became obsolete, I would upskill and learn how to use new tools.
practicumQuestions.explanation: Answer calmly and explain a clear action you would take.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Use the word workforce in a sentence about changes in employment.
practicumQuestions.audioPrompt: Say one complete sentence using workforce.
practicumQuestions.targetSentence: The workforce will be learning new skills as technology changes.
practicumQuestions.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɜːkfɔːs wɪl bi ˈlɜːnɪŋ njuː skɪlz/
practicumQuestions.explanation: Use workforce to mean the people who work in a company, industry, or country.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Complete the idea with the future perfect: By 2040, many companies...
practicumQuestions.audioPrompt: Say a sentence about what many companies will have done by 2040.
practicumQuestions.targetSentence: By 2040, many companies will have introduced new AI systems.
practicumQuestions.explanation: Use will have plus a past participle to describe something completed before a future time.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Say automation three times, stressing the correct syllable.
practicumQuestions.audioPrompt: Listen and repeat: automation, automation, automation.
practicumQuestions.targetSentence: Automation will change some jobs.
practicumQuestions.explanation: The main stress in automation is on the third syllable: au-to-MA-tion.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Say the question with a natural rising tone at the end, then say the statement with a falling tone.
practicumQuestions.audioPrompt: Ask, 'Will people be working remotely?' Then say, 'People will be working remotely.'
practicumQuestions.targetSentence: Will people be working remotely? People will be working remotely.
practicumQuestions.phonetic: /wɪl ˈpiːpəl bi ˈwɜːkɪŋ rɪˈməʊtli/ and /ˈpiːpəl wɪl bi ˈwɜːkɪŋ rɪˈməʊtli/
practicumQuestions.explanation: Use rising intonation at the end of the yes-or-no question and falling intonation at the end of the statement.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Ucapkan ajakan adaptasi sistem baru:
practicumQuestions.prompt: Adopting this new infrastructure requires initial adjustment, but the long-term productivity advantages far outweigh the transitional overhead.
practicumQuestions.sampleAnswer: Adopting this new infrastructure requires initial adjustment, but the long-term productivity advantages far outweigh the transitional overhead.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Ucapkan argumen pembenaran alokasi anggaran:
practicumQuestions.prompt: Allocating additional resources to cybersecurity is not an optional luxury, but a fundamental prerequisite for enterprise growth.
practicumQuestions.sampleAnswer: Allocating additional resources to cybersecurity is not an optional luxury, but a fundamental prerequisite for enterprise growth.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Ucapkan visi strategis jangka menengah perusahaan:
practicumQuestions.prompt: Over the next three quarters, our strategic focus will center on expanding market penetration across emerging regional economies.
practicumQuestions.sampleAnswer: Over the next three quarters, our strategic focus will center on expanding market penetration across emerging regional economies.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Ucapkan argumen presentasi kerja dengan artikulasi percaya diri:
practicumQuestions.prompt: Based on our latest customer feedback, streamlining the onboarding workflow will reduce churn by fifteen percent.
practicumQuestions.sampleAnswer: Based on our latest customer feedback, streamlining the onboarding workflow will reduce churn by fifteen percent.

practicumQuestions.instruction: Ucapkan respon diplomatis dalam negosiasi bisnis berikut:
practicumQuestions.prompt: While we appreciate your competitive pricing proposal, our priority remains long-term product reliability and technical support.
practicumQuestions.sampleAnswer: While we appreciate your competitive pricing proposal, our priority remains long-term product reliability and technical support.
